description: Source for one component styled for one era: the import lines, the TSX wrapper, the stylesheet rules that apply everywhere, the rules scoped to that era, and notes on what is easy to get wrong. The CSS is a filtered view of the stylesheet, not a verbatim copy: rules for other eras and section-divider comments are removed, while comments inside rules are kept. Components must render inside NostalgiaRoot.
